   1package com.example.brokerage.domain;
   2
   3import java.math.BigDecimal;
   4import java.math.RoundingMode;
   5import java.util.ArrayList;
   6import java.util.List;
   7
   8import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
   9
  10/**
  11 * What would happen if this order were placed.
  12 *
  13 * <p>This class is the reason the catalog has a {@code preview} tool at all. Everything a customer
  14 * needs to agree to an order — the cost, what it leaves them with, and the reasons it might be
  15 * refused — is computed here, before anything is sent anywhere, and handed back as data.
  16 *
  17 * <p>The distinction between a <em>blocker</em> and a <em>warning</em> is the most load-bearing
  18 * idea in the file. A blocker means the order would be refused: the agent must not proceed, and
  19 * the right move is to tell the customer why and, where the blocker is about size, what size
  20 * would work. A warning means the order would go through but the customer may not want it to.
  21 * Collapsing the two into one list of "issues" is how you get an agent that either ignores real
  22 * refusals or refuses to place anything at all.
  23 */
  24@Component
  25public class RiskEngine {
  26
  27    /** Blocker codes. Stable strings, because the agent is taught what each one means. */
  28    public static final String INSUFFICIENT_BUYING_POWER = "INSUFFICIENT_BUYING_POWER";
  29    public static final String INSUFFICIENT_SHARES = "INSUFFICIENT_SHARES";
  30    public static final String MARKET_CLOSED = "MARKET_CLOSED";
  31    public static final String ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED = "ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED";
  32    public static final String SHORTING_NOT_PERMITTED = "SHORTING_NOT_PERMITTED";
  33    public static final String MARGIN_NOT_PERMITTED = "MARGIN_NOT_PERMITTED";
  34    public static final String DAY_TRADE_LIMIT = "DAY_TRADE_LIMIT";
  35    public static final String ORDER_SIZE_LIMIT = "ORDER_SIZE_LIMIT";
  36    public static final String PRICE_AWAY_FROM_MARKET = "PRICE_AWAY_FROM_MARKET";
  37
  38    private static final long MAX_SHARES_PER_ORDER = 100_000L;
  39    private static final BigDecimal MAX_NOTIONAL = Money.of("500000.00");
  40    private static final BigDecimal CONCENTRATION_LIMIT = BigDecimal.valueOf(25);
  41    private static final int WIDE_SPREAD_BASIS_POINTS = 25;
  42
  43    /**
  44     * One reason the order would be refused.
  45     *
  46     * @param maxPermissibleQuantity the largest size that would be accepted, when the blocker is
  47     *                               about size. Null otherwise — and the difference matters,
  48     *                               because an agent given a number can offer the customer a
  49     *                               smaller order instead of a dead end
  50     */
  51    public record Blocker(String code, String message, Long maxPermissibleQuantity) {
  52
  53        static Blocker of(String code, String message) {
  54            return new Blocker(code, message, null);
  55        }
  56    }
  57
  58    public record Estimate(BigDecimal referencePrice, BigDecimal estimatedPrincipal,
  59                           BigDecimal commission, BigDecimal estimatedCost,
  60                           BigDecimal buyingPowerBefore, BigDecimal buyingPowerAfter,
  61                           String currency, boolean isEstimate) {
  62    }
  63
  64    public record Preview(boolean canPlace, List<Blocker> blockers, List<String> warnings,
  65                          Estimate estimate, String summary) {
  66    }
  67
  68    private final Accounts accounts;
  69    private final Instruments instruments;
  70    private final MarketData marketData;
  71    private final MarketClock clock;
  72    private final Orders orders;
  73
  74    public RiskEngine(Accounts accounts, Instruments instruments, MarketData marketData,
  75                      MarketClock clock, Orders orders) {
  76        this.accounts = accounts;
  77        this.instruments = instruments;
  78        this.marketData = marketData;
  79        this.clock = clock;
  80        this.orders = orders;
  81    }
  82
  83    public Preview preview(Orders.Ticket ticket) {
  84        Accounts.Account account = accounts.find(ticket.accountId()).orElseThrow();
  85        Instrument instrument = instruments.require(ticket.symbol());
  86        MarketData.Quote quote = marketData.quote(ticket.symbol());
  87        Accounts.Balances balances =
  88                accounts.balancesOf(ticket.accountId(), orders.cashReservedFor(ticket.accountId()));
  89
  90        boolean buying = ticket.side() == Orders.Side.BUY || ticket.side() == Orders.Side.BUY_TO_COVER;
  91        BigDecimal reference = switch (ticket.orderType()) {
  92            case MARKET -> buying ? quote.ask() : quote.bid();
  93            case LIMIT, STOP_LIMIT -> ticket.limitPrice();
  94            case STOP -> ticket.stopPrice();
  95        };
  96        BigDecimal principal = Money.times(reference, ticket.quantity());
  97        BigDecimal commission = commissionFor(instrument, ticket, principal);
  98        BigDecimal cost = buying ? principal.add(commission) : principal.subtract(commission);
  99
 100        List<Blocker> blockers = new ArrayList<>();
 101        List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
 102
 103        session(ticket, blockers, warnings);
 104        permissions(account, instrument, ticket, blockers);
 105        size(ticket, principal, blockers);
 106        funding(account, balances, ticket, buying, reference, commission, blockers);
 107        inventory(ticket, buying, blockers);
 108        pricing(ticket, quote, blockers, warnings);
 109        if (blockers.isEmpty()) {
 110            // Only worth saying when the order could actually go through. "This would be 6,794
 111            // percent of the account" on an order the account cannot fund is noise, and noise in
 112            // a warnings array is how an agent learns to skim it.
 113            concentration(ticket, principal, balances, warnings);
 114        }
 115        taxes(account, ticket, warnings);
 116
 117        BigDecimal after = buying ? balances.buyingPower().subtract(cost)
 118                : balances.buyingPower().add(cost);
 119        Estimate estimate = new Estimate(Money.cents(reference), Money.cents(principal),
 120                Money.cents(commission), Money.cents(cost), balances.buyingPower(),
 121                Money.cents(after.max(BigDecimal.ZERO)), account.currency(),
 122                ticket.orderType() == Orders.OrderType.MARKET);
 123
 124        String summary = "%s — estimated %s %s, leaving %s buying power".formatted(
 125                ticket.describe(), Money.string(cost), account.currency(),
 126                Money.string(after.max(BigDecimal.ZERO)));
 127        return new Preview(blockers.isEmpty(), blockers, warnings, estimate, summary);
 128    }
 129
 130    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ individual checks
 131
 132    private void session(Orders.Ticket ticket, List<Blocker> blockers, List<String> warnings) {
 133        MarketClock.Session session = clock.session();
 134        if (session == MarketClock.Session.CLOSED && ticket.timeInForce() != Orders.TimeInForce.GTC) {
 135            blockers.add(Blocker.of(MARKET_CLOSED,
 136                    "The market is closed and this order would expire before it could trade. The "
 137                            + "regular session next opens at " + clock.nextRegularOpen()
 138                            + ". A good-till-canceled order can be entered now instead."));
 139        }
 140        if (session != MarketClock.Session.REGULAR && session != MarketClock.Session.CLOSED) {
 141            if (ticket.orderType() == Orders.OrderType.MARKET) {
 142                blockers.add(Blocker.of(MARKET_CLOSED,
 143                        "Market orders are not accepted in the " + session.label()
 144                                + " session, where there may be no price to trade against. Use a "
 145                                + "limit order."));
 146            } else {
 147                warnings.add("This is the " + session.label() + " session: volume is thin, the "
 148                        + "spread is wider than usual, and the fill may be far from the last price.");
 149            }
 150        }
 151    }
 152
 153    private void permissions(Accounts.Account account, Instrument instrument, Orders.Ticket ticket,
 154                             List<Blocker> blockers) {
 155        if (account.restriction() == Accounts.Restriction.FROZEN) {
 156            blockers.add(Blocker.of(ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED,
 157                    "This account is under review and cannot place orders. The customer should be "
 158                            + "directed to their service team."));
 159        }
 160        if (ticket.side() == Orders.Side.SELL_SHORT && !account.type().shortingAllowed()) {
 161            blockers.add(Blocker.of(SHORTING_NOT_PERMITTED,
 162                    "A " + account.type().label() + " account cannot sell short."));
 163        }
 164        if (!instrument.marginEligible() && account.type().marginAllowed()
 165                && ticket.side() == Orders.Side.BUY) {
 166            blockers.add(Blocker.of(MARGIN_NOT_PERMITTED,
 167                    instrument.symbol() + " is not marginable, so it must be bought with settled "
 168                            + "cash rather than buying power."));
 169        }
 170        if (account.restriction() == Accounts.Restriction.DAY_TRADE_RESTRICTED) {
 171            blockers.add(Blocker.of(DAY_TRADE_LIMIT,
 172                    "This account is restricted to closing orders until the day-trade flag clears."));
 173        }
 174    }
 175
 176    private void size(Orders.Ticket ticket, BigDecimal principal, List<Blocker> blockers) {
 177        if (ticket.quantity() > MAX_SHARES_PER_ORDER) {
 178            blockers.add(new Blocker(ORDER_SIZE_LIMIT,
 179                    "A single order may not exceed " + MAX_SHARES_PER_ORDER + " shares.",
 180                    MAX_SHARES_PER_ORDER));
 181        }
 182        if (principal.compareTo(MAX_NOTIONAL) > 0) {
 183            long permissible = MAX_NOTIONAL.divide(
 184                    principal.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(ticket.quantity()), 6, RoundingMode.HALF_UP),
 185                    0, RoundingMode.DOWN).longValue();
 186            blockers.add(new Blocker(ORDER_SIZE_LIMIT,
 187                    "A single order may not exceed " + Money.string(MAX_NOTIONAL)
 188                            + " in notional value. The largest size that would be accepted at this "
 189                            + "price is " + permissible + " shares.", permissible));
 190        }
 191    }
 192
 193    private void funding(Accounts.Account account, Accounts.Balances balances, Orders.Ticket ticket,
 194                         boolean buying, BigDecimal reference, BigDecimal commission,
 195                         List<Blocker> blockers) {
 196        if (!buying) {
 197            return;
 198        }
 199        BigDecimal need = Money.times(reference, ticket.quantity()).add(commission);
 200        BigDecimal available = account.type().marginAllowed()
 201                ? balances.buyingPower() : balances.settledCash();
 202        if (need.compareTo(available) > 0) {
 203            long permissible = available.subtract(commission).max(BigDecimal.ZERO)
 204                    .divide(reference, 0, RoundingMode.DOWN).longValue();
 205            blockers.add(new Blocker(INSUFFICIENT_BUYING_POWER,
 206                    "This order needs " + Money.string(need) + " " + account.currency()
 207                            + " and the account has " + Money.string(available)
 208                            + " available. The largest size this account could buy at this price "
 209                            + "is " + permissible + " shares.",
 210                    permissible));
 211        }
 212    }
 213
 214    private void inventory(Orders.Ticket ticket, boolean buying, List<Blocker> blockers) {
 215        if (buying || ticket.side() == Orders.Side.SELL_SHORT) {
 216            return;
 217        }
 218        long held = accounts.sharesHeld(ticket.accountId(), ticket.symbol());
 219        if (ticket.quantity() > held) {
 220            blockers.add(new Blocker(INSUFFICIENT_SHARES,
 221                    "The account holds " + held + " shares of " + ticket.symbol()
 222                            + " and this order would sell " + ticket.quantity()
 223                            + ". Selling more than is held is a short sale and must be entered as "
 224                            + "SELL_SHORT.", held));
 225        }
 226    }
 227
 228    private void pricing(Orders.Ticket ticket, MarketData.Quote quote, List<Blocker> blockers,
 229                         List<String> warnings) {
 230        if (quote.spreadBasisPoints() >= WIDE_SPREAD_BASIS_POINTS) {
 231            warnings.add("The spread on " + ticket.symbol() + " is "
 232                    + quote.spreadBasisPoints() + " basis points, which is wide. A market order "
 233                    + "could fill well away from the last price of " + Money.price(quote.last())
 234                    + "; a limit order would cap that.");
 235        }
 236        BigDecimal limit = ticket.limitPrice();
 237        if (limit == null) {
 238            return;
 239        }
 240        BigDecimal away = limit.subtract(quote.last()).abs()
 241                .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100))
 242                .divide(quote.last(), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
 243        if (away.compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(30)) > 0) {
 244            blockers.add(Blocker.of(PRICE_AWAY_FROM_MARKET,
 245                    "A limit of " + Money.price(limit) + " is " + away
 246                            + " percent away from the last price of " + Money.price(quote.last())
 247                            + ". Orders that far from the market are rejected as a protection "
 248                            + "against a mistyped price."));
 249        } else if (away.compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(10)) > 0) {
 250            warnings.add("The limit of " + Money.price(limit) + " is " + away
 251                    + " percent away from the last price, so this order may sit unfilled for a "
 252                    + "long time. Confirm the price is what the customer intended.");
 253        }
 254    }
 255
 256    private void concentration(Orders.Ticket ticket, BigDecimal principal,
 257                               Accounts.Balances balances, List<String> warnings) {
 258        if (balances.totalEquity().signum() <= 0) {
 259            return;
 260        }
 261        BigDecimal existing = accounts.positionsOf(ticket.accountId()).stream()
 262                .filter(position -> position.symbol().equals(ticket.symbol()))
 263                .map(Accounts.Position::marketValue)
 264                .findFirst().orElse(BigDecimal.ZERO);
 265        BigDecimal after = existing.add(principal).multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100))
 266                .divide(balances.totalEquity(), 1, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
 267        if (after.compareTo(CONCENTRATION_LIMIT) > 0) {
 268            warnings.add("After this order, " + ticket.symbol() + " would be " + after
 269                    + " percent of the account. That is a concentrated position; say so before the "
 270                    + "customer confirms.");
 271        }
 272    }
 273
 274    private void taxes(Accounts.Account account, Orders.Ticket ticket, List<String> warnings) {
 275        if (account.type().retirement() || ticket.side() != Orders.Side.SELL) {
 276            return;
 277        }
 278        List<Accounts.TaxLot> lots = accounts.lotsOf(ticket.accountId(), ticket.symbol());
 279        if (lots.stream().anyMatch(Accounts.TaxLot::washSaleRisk)) {
 280            warnings.add("Some lots of " + ticket.symbol() + " were bought within the last 30 days, "
 281                    + "so selling at a loss may trigger a wash sale. The customer may want to "
 282                    + "choose which lots to sell.");
 283        }
 284        if (lots.stream().anyMatch(lot -> !lot.longTerm())
 285                && lots.stream().anyMatch(Accounts.TaxLot::longTerm)) {
 286            warnings.add("This holding has both long-term and short-term lots, which are taxed "
 287                    + "differently. Offer the customer the lot breakdown before selling.");
 288        }
 289    }
 290
 291    /**
 292     * Commission. Zero per trade on equities, which is the market reality, plus the regulatory
 293     * fees that are not zero and that a customer notices when the total is a few cents off.
 294     */
 295    private BigDecimal commissionFor(Instrument instrument, Orders.Ticket ticket,
 296                                     BigDecimal principal) {
 297        if (ticket.side() == Orders.Side.BUY || ticket.side() == Orders.Side.BUY_TO_COVER) {
 298            return Money.of("0.00");
 299        }
 300        BigDecimal secFee = principal.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(0.0000278));
 301        BigDecimal tafFee = BigDecimal.valueOf(ticket.quantity())
 302                .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(0.000166)).min(Money.of("8.30"));
 303        return Money.cents(secFee.add(tafFee));
 304    }
 305}

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog;
   2
   3import java.math.BigDecimal;
   4import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
   5import java.util.List;
   6import java.util.Map;
   7
   8import com.example.brokerage.domain.Accounts;
   9import com.example.brokerage.domain.Brokerage;
  10import com.example.brokerage.domain.Money;
  11import com.example.brokerage.domain.Orders;
  12import com.example.brokerage.domain.RiskEngine;
  13import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ApprovalContext;
  14import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.Invocation;
  15
  16import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  17
  18/**
  19 * What the customer actually sees before they approve a trade.
  20 *
  21 * <p>Everything here is computed at the moment of the confirmation, not carried forward from the
  22 * preview the agent ran. That is the important choice. The preview may have been a minute ago, the
  23 * agent may have had two turns of conversation since, and the customer is agreeing <em>now</em>.
  24 * Re-pricing costs one read-only call and removes a whole class of complaint that begins "but it
  25 * said it would cost".
  26 *
  27 * <p>If the order can no longer be placed at all, the dialog says so instead of quoting a cost.
  28 * A confirmation prompt for an order that would be refused is worse than useless: the customer
  29 * says yes, the tool refuses, and they have learned that the approval step is theatre.
  30 */
  31@Component
  32public class BrokerageApprovalContext implements ApprovalContext {
  33
  34    private final Brokerage brokerage;
  35
  36    public BrokerageApprovalContext(Brokerage brokerage) {
  37        this.brokerage = brokerage;
  38    }
  39
  40    @Override
  41    public Map<String, String> enrich(Invocation invocation) {
  42        Map<String, String> values = new LinkedHashMap<>();
  43        String accountId = invocation.string("accountId");
  44        Accounts.Account account = accountId == null ? null
  45                : brokerage.accounts().find(accountId).orElse(null);
  46        if (account == null) {
  47            return values;
  48        }
  49        values.put("accountNickname", account.nickname() + " (" + account.type().label() + ")");
  50        values.put("currency", account.currency());
  51
  52        return switch (invocation.descriptor().name()) {
  53            case "brokerage_order_place" -> placing(invocation, account, values);
  54            case "brokerage_order_replace" -> replacing(invocation, account, values);
  55            case "brokerage_order_cancel" -> cancelling(invocation, values);
  56            default -> values;
  57        };
  58    }
  59
  60    private Map<String, String> placing(Invocation invocation, Accounts.Account account,
  61                                        Map<String, String> values) {
  62        Orders.OrderType type = Orders.OrderType.valueOf(invocation.string("orderType"));
  63        BigDecimal limit = decimal(invocation, "limitPrice");
  64        BigDecimal stop = decimal(invocation, "stopPrice");
  65        Orders.Ticket ticket = new Orders.Ticket(account.accountId(), invocation.string("symbol"),
  66                Orders.Side.valueOf(invocation.string("side")), invocation.integer("quantity"),
  67                type, limit, stop,
  68                Orders.TimeInForce.valueOf(invocation.string("timeInForce", "DAY")),
  69                invocation.flag("extendedHours", false));
  70        values.put("orderTypeDescription", describe(type, limit, stop));
  71        values.put("timeInForce", ticket.timeInForce().name());
  72        price(ticket, values);
  73        return values;
  74    }
  75
  76    private Map<String, String> replacing(Invocation invocation, Accounts.Account account,
  77                                          Map<String, String> values) {
  78        String orderId = invocation.string("orderId");
  79        Orders.Order order = brokerage.orders().find(orderId).orElse(null);
  80        if (order == null) {
  81            return values;
  82        }
  83        BigDecimal limit = decimal(invocation, "limitPrice");
  84        BigDecimal stop = decimal(invocation, "stopPrice");
  85        values.put("symbol", order.symbol());
  86        values.put("side", order.side().name());
  87        values.put("previousTerms", order.quantity() + " shares, "
  88                + describe(order.orderType(), order.limitPrice(), order.stopPrice()));
  89        values.put("newTerms", invocation.integer("quantity") + " shares, "
  90                + describe(order.orderType(), limit, stop));
  91        price(new Orders.Ticket(account.accountId(), order.symbol(), order.side(),
  92                invocation.integer("quantity"), order.orderType(), limit, stop,
  93                order.timeInForce(), false), values);
  94        return values;
  95    }
  96
  97    private Map<String, String> cancelling(Invocation invocation, Map<String, String> values) {
  98        Orders.Order order = brokerage.orders().find(invocation.string("orderId")).orElse(null);
  99        if (order == null) {
 100            return values;
 101        }
 102        values.put("symbol", order.symbol());
 103        values.put("side", order.side().name());
 104        values.put("quantity", String.valueOf(order.quantity()));
 105        values.put("filledQuantity", String.valueOf(order.filledQuantity()));
 106        values.put("orderTypeDescription",
 107                describe(order.orderType(), order.limitPrice(), order.stopPrice()));
 108        return values;
 109    }
 110
 111    /** Re-price the order now, and say plainly if it would no longer be accepted. */
 112    private void price(Orders.Ticket ticket, Map<String, String> values) {
 113        RiskEngine.Preview preview = brokerage.risk().preview(ticket);
 114        values.put("estimatedCost", Money.string(preview.estimate().estimatedCost()));
 115        values.put("buyingPowerAfter", Money.string(preview.estimate().buyingPowerAfter()));
 116        if (!preview.canPlace()) {
 117            values.put("warnings", "This order would now be refused: "
 118                    + preview.blockers().getFirst().message());
 119            return;
 120        }
 121        List<String> warnings = preview.warnings();
 122        values.put("warnings", warnings.isEmpty() ? "" : "Note: " + String.join(" ", warnings));
 123    }
 124
 125    private static String describe(Orders.OrderType type, BigDecimal limit, BigDecimal stop) {
 126        return switch (type) {
 127            case MARKET -> "at market";
 128            case LIMIT -> "limit " + Money.price(limit);
 129            case STOP -> "stop " + Money.price(stop);
 130            case STOP_LIMIT -> "stop " + Money.price(stop) + " limit " + Money.price(limit);
 131        };
 132    }
 133
 134    private static BigDecimal decimal(Invocation invocation, String field) {
 135        String raw = invocation.string(field);
 136        return raw == null ? null : Money.of(raw);
 137    }
 138}

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog;
   2
   3import java.io.IOException;
   4import java.io.InputStream;
   5import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
   6import java.util.ArrayList;
   7import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
   8import java.util.List;
   9import java.util.Map;
  10import java.util.Optional;
  11
  12import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.DescriptorCodec;
  13import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.Ontology;
  14import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolDescriptor;
  15
  16import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  17
  18/**
  19 * The catalog as published: the ontology and the fourteen descriptors, read from the classpath.
  20 *
  21 * <p>The descriptors are JSON files rather than Java builders, and that is a deliberate choice
  22 * with consequences worth stating. A descriptor in JSON can be linted by anything, diffed by a
  23 * reviewer who does not write Java, served to a desktop client without the application running,
  24 * and compared byte for byte against what production is serving. A descriptor assembled in code
  25 * can be none of those things, and the first time somebody asks "what exactly is the model being
  26 * shown right now" you will be reading a builder and guessing.
  27 *
  28 * <p>The order of {@link #NAMES} is the order the tools are presented in. It is not alphabetical.
  29 * Reads come before writes, and within the reads the ones that produce identifiers come first,
  30 * because a model reading a catalog top to bottom should meet the tools in roughly the order it
  31 * will need them.
  32 */
  33@Component
  34public class BrokerageCatalog {
  35
  36    public static final String ONTOLOGY_RESOURCE = "/ontology/brokerage.ontology.json";
  37    public static final String CONDUCT_RESOURCE = "/prompts/conduct.md";
  38
  39    /** Presentation order: entry points, then the rest of the reads, then the writes. */
  40    public static final List<String> NAMES = List.of(
  41            "brokerage_accounts_list",
  42            "brokerage_instruments_search",
  43            "brokerage_quotes_get",
  44            "brokerage_price_history_get",
  45            "brokerage_balances_get",
  46            "brokerage_positions_list",
  47            "brokerage_tax_lots_list",
  48            "brokerage_orders_list",
  49            "brokerage_order_get",
  50            "brokerage_executions_list",
  51            "brokerage_order_preview",
  52            "brokerage_order_place",
  53            "brokerage_order_replace",
  54            "brokerage_order_cancel");
  55
  56    private final Ontology ontology;
  57    private final String conduct;
  58    private final Map<String, ToolDescriptor> descriptors = new LinkedHashMap<>();
  59
  60    public BrokerageCatalog() {
  61        this.ontology = load(ONTOLOGY_RESOURCE, Ontology::read);
  62        this.conduct = load(CONDUCT_RESOURCE, in -> new String(in.readAllBytes()));
  63        for (String name : NAMES) {
  64            descriptors.put(name, load("/catalog/" + name + ".json", DescriptorCodec::read));
  65        }
  66    }
  67
  68    /**
  69     * The conduct half of the system prompt: how the assistant behaves, as distinct from what the
  70     * tools are. It lives in a file beside the descriptors because it is policy — the compliance
  71     * team should be able to read it and propose a change without opening an IDE — and because the
  72     * agent and the evaluation harness must be reading the same copy. A harness that evaluates a
  73     * different prompt from the one production uses is measuring a system nobody ships.
  74     */
  75    public String conduct() {
  76        return conduct;
  77    }
  78
  79    private interface Reader<T> {
  80        T read(InputStream in) throws IOException;
  81    }
  82
  83    private static <T> T load(String resource, Reader<T> reader) {
  84        InputStream in = BrokerageCatalog.class.getResourceAsStream(resource);
  85        if (in == null) {
  86            throw new IllegalStateException("missing catalog resource " + resource);
  87        }
  88        try {
  89            return reader.read(in);
  90        } catch (IOException e) {
  91            throw new UncheckedIOException("cannot read " + resource, e);
  92        }
  93    }
  94
  95    public Ontology ontology() {
  96        return ontology;
  97    }
  98
  99    public List<ToolDescriptor> descriptors() {
 100        return new ArrayList<>(descriptors.values());
 101    }
 102
 103    public Optional<ToolDescriptor> find(String name) {
 104        return Optional.ofNullable(descriptors.get(name));
 105    }
 106
 107    public ToolDescriptor require(String name) {
 108        return find(name).orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("no tool " + name));
 109    }
 110
 111    public int size() {
 112        return descriptors.size();
 113    }
 114}

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog;
   2
   3import java.time.Instant;
   4import java.util.List;
   5import java.util.function.Supplier;
   6
   7import com.example.brokerage.domain.MarketClock;
   8import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ApprovalContext;
   9import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolHandler;
  10import com.example.brokerage.tooling.runtime.ApprovalGate;
  11import com.example.brokerage.tooling.runtime.AuditLog;
  12import com.example.brokerage.tooling.runtime.InvocationPipeline;
  13import com.example.brokerage.tooling.runtime.KillSwitches;
  14import com.example.brokerage.tooling.runtime.RateLimiter;
  15import com.example.brokerage.tooling.runtime.ToolPublisher;
  16import com.example.brokerage.tooling.runtime.ToolRegistry;
  17
  18import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
  19import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
  20
  21/**
  22 * Wiring. Short, because the pieces are decoupled on purpose, and it lives in the catalog module
  23 * rather than in any one application because three different front ends need the same runtime:
  24 * the agent service, the desktop connector and the evaluation harness. A catalog that each of them
  25 * wired up for itself would be three catalogs with the same name.
  26 *
  27 * <p>The registry is built from three inputs that know nothing about each other: an ontology, a
  28 * list of descriptors, and a list of handlers discovered by Spring. If any of the three disagrees
  29 * with the others — a handler with no descriptor, a descriptor outside the ontology, a descriptor
  30 * that fails the linter — the application fails to start. Shipping a half-correct catalog is not
  31 * one of the available outcomes.
  32 */
  33@Configuration
  34public class BrokerageRuntimeConfiguration {
  35
  36    @Bean
  37    Supplier<Instant> toolClock(MarketClock clock) {
  38        return clock::now;
  39    }
  40
  41    @Bean
  42    ToolRegistry toolRegistry(BrokerageCatalog catalog, List<ToolHandler> handlers) {
  43        return new ToolRegistry(catalog.ontology(), catalog.descriptors(), handlers);
  44    }
  45
  46    @Bean
  47    ApprovalGate approvalGate() {
  48        return new ApprovalGate();
  49    }
  50
  51    @Bean
  52    RateLimiter rateLimiter() {
  53        return new RateLimiter();
  54    }
  55
  56    @Bean
  57    KillSwitches killSwitches() {
  58        return new KillSwitches();
  59    }
  60
  61    @Bean
  62    AuditLog auditLog() {
  63        return new AuditLog();
  64    }
  65
  66    @Bean
  67    InvocationPipeline invocationPipeline(ToolRegistry registry, ApprovalGate approvals,
  68                                          RateLimiter rateLimiter, KillSwitches killSwitches,
  69                                          AuditLog audit, ApprovalContext approvalContext,
  70                                          Supplier<Instant> clock) {
  71        return new InvocationPipeline(registry, approvals, rateLimiter, killSwitches, audit,
  72                approvalContext, clock);
  73    }
  74
  75    @Bean
  76    ToolPublisher toolPublisher(ToolRegistry registry, InvocationPipeline pipeline) {
  77        return new ToolPublisher(registry, pipeline);
  78    }
  79}

brokerage-catalog/src/main/java/com/example/brokerage/catalog/CatalogLint.java38 lines

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog;
   2
   3import java.util.List;
   4
   5import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ConformanceLinter;
   6import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.Finding;
   7
   8/**
   9 * The conformance gate as a command, for a CI step that wants an exit status and a readable log.
  10 *
  11 * <pre>
  12 *   ./mvnw -q -pl brokerage-catalog exec:java -Dexec.mainClass=\
  13 *       com.example.brokerage.catalog.CatalogLint
  14 * </pre>
  15 *
  16 * <p>The same rules run as a unit test, which is what actually fails the build. Both exist on
  17 * purpose: the test fails the build for everyone, and the command gives whoever is writing a
  18 * descriptor a one-second loop instead of a Maven cycle.
  19 */
  20public final class CatalogLint {
  21
  22    private CatalogLint() {
  23    }
  24
  25    public static void main(String[] args) {
  26        BrokerageCatalog catalog = new BrokerageCatalog();
  27        List<Finding> findings = new ConformanceLinter(catalog.ontology()).lint(catalog.descriptors());
  28        findings.stream().sorted((a, b) -> a.severity().compareTo(b.severity()))
  29                .forEach(finding -> System.out.println("  " + finding));
  30        long errors = findings.stream().filter(f -> f.severity() == Finding.Severity.ERROR).count();
  31        long warnings = findings.stream().filter(f -> f.severity() == Finding.Severity.WARNING).count();
  32        System.out.printf("%n  %d descriptors - %d errors - %d warnings - %d capabilities%n",
  33                catalog.size(), errors, warnings, catalog.ontology().capabilities().size());
  34        if (errors > 0) {
  35            System.exit(1);
  36        }
  37    }
  38}

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog.handlers;
   2
   3import com.example.brokerage.domain.Accounts;
   4import com.example.brokerage.domain.Brokerage;
   5import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.Invocation;
   6import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolFailure;
   7
   8import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
   9
  10/**
  11 * Resolves the {@code accountId} argument and proves the session is entitled to it.
  12 *
  13 * <p>Every handler that takes an account calls this first. The pipeline has already checked that
  14 * the principal holds the right scope, but a scope says "this session may read accounts", not
  15 * "this session may read <em>that</em> account". The second check cannot be done generically,
  16 * because only the domain knows who owns what, so it is done here — once, in one place, by every
  17 * handler that needs it.
  18 *
  19 * <p>The error is {@link com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ErrorCode#NOT_FOUND} and not
  20 * {@code NOT_ENTITLED}, which is the detail most worth copying. An authorization error tells the
  21 * caller the account exists and belongs to somebody else. A not-found error tells them nothing.
  22 * Since an agent cannot act on either, there is no cost to the honest-sounding answer and a real
  23 * cost to the informative one: an enumeration oracle, driven by a model that will happily try a
  24 * hundred identifiers if a prompt suggests it.
  25 */
  26@Component
  27public class AccountGuard {
  28
  29    private final Brokerage brokerage;
  30
  31    public AccountGuard(Brokerage brokerage) {
  32        this.brokerage = brokerage;
  33    }
  34
  35    public Accounts.Account require(Invocation invocation) {
  36        return require(invocation, invocation.string("accountId"));
  37    }
  38
  39    public Accounts.Account require(Invocation invocation, String accountId) {
  40        Accounts.Account account = brokerage.accounts().find(accountId)
  41                .filter(a -> a.customerId().equals(invocation.principal().customerId()))
  42                .orElseThrow(() -> ToolFailure.notFound("Account " + accountId,
  43                        "Call brokerage_accounts_list to get the accounts this customer actually "
  44                                + "holds, and use an accountId from that result."));
  45        return account;
  46    }
  47
  48    /** The same resolution, plus a refusal when the account cannot trade at all. */
  49    public Accounts.Account requireTradeable(Invocation invocation) {
  50        Accounts.Account account = require(invocation);
  51        if (!account.tradeable()) {
  52            throw ToolFailure.precondition(
  53                    "Account " + account.nickname() + " is " + account.restriction()
  54                            + " and cannot place or change orders.",
  55                    "Tell the customer the account is restricted and that their service team can "
  56                            + "explain it. Do not try another account on their behalf.");
  57        }
  58        return account;
  59    }
  60}

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog.handlers;
   2
   3import java.time.LocalDate;
   4import java.util.List;
   5
   6import com.example.brokerage.domain.Accounts;
   7import com.example.brokerage.domain.Brokerage;
   8import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.Invocation;
   9import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolHandler;
  10
  11import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  12
  13/**
  14 * {@code brokerage_accounts_list}.
  15 *
  16 * <p>The shortest handler in the catalog, and worth reading first for that reason. It takes the
  17 * customer from the principal — never from an argument — maps the domain's accounts into the shape
  18 * the output schema promises, and stops.
  19 *
  20 * <p>The one judgment it makes is to project {@code restriction} into a {@code tradeable} boolean
  21 * as well as passing the restriction itself. The model is perfectly capable of working out that
  22 * {@code FROZEN} means it cannot trade, but "perfectly capable" is a per-call probability, and a
  23 * boolean is a certainty. Where a conclusion matters and is cheap to compute, compute it.
  24 */
  25@Component
  26public class AccountsListHandler implements ToolHandler {
  27
  28    record AccountView(String accountId, String nickname, String type, String currency,
  29                       LocalDate openedOn, boolean tradeable, String restriction) {
  30    }
  31
  32    record Payload(List<AccountView> accounts) {
  33    }
  34
  35    private final Brokerage brokerage;
  36
  37    public AccountsListHandler(Brokerage brokerage) {
  38        this.brokerage = brokerage;
  39    }
  40
  41    @Override
  42    public String name() {
  43        return "brokerage_accounts_list";
  44    }
  45
  46    @Override
  47    public Object handle(Invocation invocation) {
  48        List<AccountView> accounts =
  49                brokerage.accounts().forCustomer(invocation.principal().customerId()).stream()
  50                        .map(AccountsListHandler::view)
  51                        .toList();
  52        return new Payload(accounts);
  53    }
  54
  55    private static AccountView view(Accounts.Account account) {
  56        return new AccountView(account.accountId(), account.nickname(), account.type().name(),
  57                account.currency(), account.openedOn(), account.tradeable(),
  58                account.restriction() == null ? null : account.restriction().name());
  59    }
  60}

brokerage-catalog/src/main/java/com/example/brokerage/catalog/handlers/Cursors.java51 lines

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog.handlers;
   2
   3import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
   4import java.util.Base64;
   5
   6import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolFailure;
   7
   8/**
   9 * Opaque forward cursors.
  10 *
  11 * <p>This implementation encodes an offset, which is honest about what it is: a demonstration. The
  12 * encoding is the point, not the content. Because the cursor is opaque, the day this service moves
  13 * to a keyset cursor over {@code (placedAt, orderId)} is a day no caller has to change, no
  14 * descriptor has to be re-reviewed, and no model has to be re-evaluated. Publish an integer page
  15 * number instead and you have published a contract you did not mean to.
  16 *
  17 * <p>A malformed cursor is {@code INVALID_ARGUMENT} rather than a silent reset to the first page.
  18 * Silently starting over means an agent paging through a long list can loop forever, each time
  19 * reporting the same first page as new.
  20 */
  21final class Cursors {
  22
  23    private static final String PREFIX = "o:";
  24
  25    private Cursors() {
  26    }
  27
  28    static String encode(int offset) {
  29        return Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding()
  30                .encodeToString((PREFIX + offset).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
  31    }
  32
  33    static int offset(String cursor) {
  34        if (cursor == null || cursor.isBlank()) {
  35            return 0;
  36        }
  37        try {
  38            String decoded = new String(Base64.getUrlDecoder().decode(cursor),
  39                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
  40            if (!decoded.startsWith(PREFIX)) {
  41                throw new IllegalArgumentException("bad prefix");
  42            }
  43            return Integer.parseInt(decoded.substring(PREFIX.length()));
  44        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
  45            throw ToolFailure.invalidArgument(
  46                    "That cursor was not issued by this tool.",
  47                    "Drop the cursor and call again from the start, or pass back a nextCursor "
  48                            + "exactly as it was returned.");
  49        }
  50    }
  51}

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog.handlers;
   2
   3import java.time.Instant;
   4import java.time.LocalDate;
   5import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
   6import java.util.List;
   7
   8import com.example.brokerage.domain.Accounts;
   9import com.example.brokerage.domain.Brokerage;
  10import com.example.brokerage.domain.MarketClock;
  11import com.example.brokerage.domain.Money;
  12import com.example.brokerage.domain.Orders;
  13import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.Invocation;
  14import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolFailure;
  15import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolHandler;
  16
  17import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  18
  19/**
  20 * {@code brokerage_executions_list}.
  21 *
  22 * <p>The default window is 30 days. An unbounded default is how a tool that was fine in testing
  23 * returns four years of fills to a long-standing customer and blows the context window on the
  24 * first call of the conversation. Every list tool in this catalog has a bounded default, and the
  25 * descriptor says what it is.
  26 */
  27@Component
  28public class ExecutionsListHandler implements ToolHandler {
  29
  30    record ExecutionView(String executionId, String orderId, String symbol, String side,
  31                         long quantity, String price, String principal, String commission,
  32                         Instant executedAt, LocalDate settlesOn, String venue) {
  33    }
  34
  35    record Payload(String accountId, String currency, List<ExecutionView> executions,
  36                   String nextCursor, Instant asOf) {
  37    }
  38
  39    private static final int DEFAULT_WINDOW_DAYS = 30;
  40
  41    private final Brokerage brokerage;
  42    private final AccountGuard guard;
  43
  44    public ExecutionsListHandler(Brokerage brokerage, AccountGuard guard) {
  45        this.brokerage = brokerage;
  46        this.guard = guard;
  47    }
  48
  49    @Override
  50    public String name() {
  51        return "brokerage_executions_list";
  52    }
  53
  54    @Override
  55    public Object handle(Invocation invocation) {
  56        Accounts.Account account = guard.require(invocation);
  57        Instant since = since(invocation);
  58        List<Orders.Execution> all = brokerage.orders().executionsOf(account.accountId(),
  59                invocation.string("symbol"), since);
  60        int from = Cursors.offset(invocation.string("cursor"));
  61        int limit = invocation.integer("limit", 20);
  62        List<Orders.Execution> page = all.stream().skip(from).limit(limit).toList();
  63        String next = from + page.size() < all.size() ? Cursors.encode(from + page.size()) : null;
  64        return new Payload(account.accountId(), account.currency(),
  65                page.stream().map(ExecutionsListHandler::view).toList(), next,
  66                brokerage.clock().now());
  67    }
  68
  69    private Instant since(Invocation invocation) {
  70        String given = invocation.string("since");
  71        if (given == null) {
  72            return brokerage.clock().now().minus(DEFAULT_WINDOW_DAYS, ChronoUnit.DAYS);
  73        }
  74        try {
  75            return LocalDate.parse(given).atStartOfDay(MarketClock.EXCHANGE).toInstant();
  76        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
  77            throw ToolFailure.invalidArgument(
  78                    "since must be a date in the form 2026-09-01.",
  79                    "Re-send with an ISO date, or omit it for the last 30 days.");
  80        }
  81    }
  82
  83    private static ExecutionView view(Orders.Execution execution) {
  84        return new ExecutionView(execution.executionId(), execution.orderId(), execution.symbol(),
  85                execution.side().name(), execution.quantity(), Money.price(execution.price()),
  86                Money.string(Money.times(execution.price(), execution.quantity())),
  87                Money.string(execution.commission()), execution.executedAt(),
  88                execution.settlesOn(), execution.venue());
  89    }
  90}

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog.handlers;

   3import java.util.List;

   5
   6import com.example.brokerage.domain.Brokerage;
   7import com.example.brokerage.domain.Instrument;
   8import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.Invocation;
   9import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolHandler;
  10
  11import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  12
  13/**
  14 * {@code brokerage_instruments_search}.
  15 *
  16 * <p>This handler's whole design is one decision: it does not choose. It returns candidates and an
  17 * {@code exactMatch} flag, and leaves the choosing to the agent, which will put it to the customer.
  18 *
  19 * <p>The temptation to choose is strong, because 90 percent of queries have an obvious answer and
  20 * returning one row makes the agent's job easier. The 10 percent is the problem. "Buy me some
  21 * Apple" has two plausible tickers, "buy Google" has two share classes, and an order is not
  22 * reversible. A tool that silently resolves ambiguity has moved a decision from the customer to a
  23 * ranking function, and nobody reviewed the ranking function.
  24 */
  25@Component
  26public class InstrumentsSearchHandler implements ToolHandler {
  27
  28    record Candidate(String symbol, String name, String exchange, String type, String sector,
  29                     boolean marginEligible) {
  30    }
  31
  32    record Payload(boolean exactMatch, List<Candidate> candidates) {
  33    }
  34
  35    private final Brokerage brokerage;
  36
  37    public InstrumentsSearchHandler(Brokerage brokerage) {
  38        this.brokerage = brokerage;
  39    }
  40
  41    @Override
  42    public String name() {
  43        return "brokerage_instruments_search";
  44    }
  45
  46    @Override
  47    public Object handle(Invocation invocation) {
  48        String query = invocation.string("query").trim();
  49        int limit = invocation.integer("limit", 5);
  50        List<Instrument> found = brokerage.instruments().search(query, limit);
  51        boolean exact = found.size() == 1
  52                && found.getFirst().symbol().equals(query.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
  53        return new Payload(exact, found.stream().map(InstrumentsSearchHandler::candidate).toList());
  54    }
  55
  56    private static Candidate candidate(Instrument instrument) {
  57        return new Candidate(instrument.symbol(), instrument.name(), instrument.exchange(),
  58                instrument.type().name(), instrument.sector(), instrument.marginEligible());
  59    }
  60}

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog.handlers;
   2
   3import java.time.Instant;
   4
   5import com.example.brokerage.domain.Accounts;
   6import com.example.brokerage.domain.Brokerage;
   7import com.example.brokerage.domain.Orders;
   8import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.Invocation;
   9import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolFailure;
  10import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolHandler;
  11
  12import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  13
  14/**
  15 * {@code brokerage_order_cancel}.
  16 *
  17 * <p>Tier 2 and no confirmation token, which is the one asymmetry in this catalog and the one most
  18 * worth defending. Cancelling reduces exposure. Requiring a priced preview before a customer can
  19 * stop an order would mean that in the one situation where speed matters — a price running away
  20 * from them — the system is slowest. A human still approves the call; what it does not need is a
  21 * round trip through the risk engine to find out what stopping something would cost.
  22 *
  23 * <p>The handler's real job is honesty about the race. {@code cancelled: false} with
  24 * {@code status: FILLED} is a successful call reporting a fill, not a failure, and the explanation
  25 * says so in words the agent can read to the customer. The failure mode this prevents is specific
  26 * and bad: an agent that says "I've cancelled that for you" about an order that filled, leaving a
  27 * customer who believes they are flat and is not.
  28 */
  29@Component
  30public class OrderCancelHandler implements ToolHandler {
  31
  32    record Payload(boolean cancelled, String orderId, String symbol, String side, long quantity,
  33                   long filledQuantity, String status, String explanation, Instant updatedAt) {
  34    }
  35
  36    private final Brokerage brokerage;
  37    private final AccountGuard guard;
  38
  39    public OrderCancelHandler(Brokerage brokerage, AccountGuard guard) {
  40        this.brokerage = brokerage;
  41        this.guard = guard;
  42    }
  43
  44    @Override
  45    public String name() {
  46        return "brokerage_order_cancel";
  47    }
  48
  49    @Override
  50    public Object handle(Invocation invocation) {
  51        Accounts.Account account = guard.require(invocation);
  52        String orderId = invocation.string("orderId");
  53        brokerage.orders().find(orderId)
  54                .filter(found -> found.accountId().equals(account.accountId()))
  55                .orElseThrow(() -> ToolFailure.notFound("Order " + orderId,
  56                        "Call brokerage_orders_list for this account and use an orderId from it."));
  57
  58        Orders.CancelOutcome outcome = brokerage.orders().cancel(orderId);
  59        Orders.Order order = outcome.order();
  60        return new Payload(outcome.accepted(), order.orderId(), order.symbol(),
  61                order.side().name(), order.quantity(), order.filledQuantity(),
  62                order.status().name(), outcome.explanation(), order.updatedAt());
  63    }
  64}

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog.handlers;
   2
   3import java.time.Instant;
   4
   5import com.example.brokerage.domain.Accounts;
   6import com.example.brokerage.domain.Brokerage;
   7import com.example.brokerage.domain.ConfirmationTokens;
   8import com.example.brokerage.domain.Money;
   9import com.example.brokerage.domain.Orders;
  10import com.example.brokerage.domain.RiskEngine;
  11import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ErrorCode;
  12import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.Invocation;
  13import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolFailure;
  14import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolHandler;
  15
  16import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  17
  18/**
  19 * {@code brokerage_order_place}. The only tool here that spends the customer's money.
  20 *
  21 * <p>Read the order of operations, because it is the whole design. The token is redeemed
  22 * <em>before</em> the order is sent, and redeeming it is what proves that these exact terms were
  23 * priced and approved. Then the risk check is run again, because two minutes have passed and the
  24 * market has moved; a preview is a promise about the moment it was taken, not a license.
  25 *
  26 * <p>The idempotency key is derived from the token, not supplied by the model. That is a small line
  27 * with a large consequence. A model asked for a unique key will sometimes reuse one and sometimes
  28 * invent a new one on a retry, and either failure mode defeats the guarantee. Deriving the key
  29 * from the single-use token means a retried call is recognizably the same call, and
  30 * {@code duplicateOfPreviousCall} tells the agent so in a field it cannot misread.
  31 */
  32@Component
  33public class OrderPlaceHandler implements ToolHandler {
  34
  35    record Payload(String orderId, String accountId, String symbol, String side, long quantity,
  36                   long filledQuantity, String status, String averageFillPrice, String commission,
  37                   String rejectReason, boolean duplicateOfPreviousCall, Instant placedAt) {
  38    }
  39
  40    private final Brokerage brokerage;
  41    private final AccountGuard guard;
  42    private final Tickets tickets;
  43
  44    public OrderPlaceHandler(Brokerage brokerage, AccountGuard guard, Tickets tickets) {
  45        this.brokerage = brokerage;
  46        this.guard = guard;
  47        this.tickets = tickets;
  48    }
  49
  50    @Override
  51    public String name() {
  52        return "brokerage_order_place";
  53    }
  54
  55    @Override
  56    public Object handle(Invocation invocation) {
  57        Accounts.Account account = guard.requireTradeable(invocation);
  58        Orders.Ticket ticket = tickets.from(invocation, account.accountId());
  59        String token = invocation.string("confirmationToken");
  60
  61        ConfirmationTokens.Redemption redemption =
  62                brokerage.confirmations().redeem(token, ticket, invocation.principal().sessionId());
  63        if (redemption instanceof ConfirmationTokens.Redemption.Refused refused) {
  64            if (refused.rejection() == ConfirmationTokens.Rejection.SPENT) {
  65                Orders.Order original =
  66                        brokerage.orders().byIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey(token)).orElse(null);
  67                if (original != null) {
  68                    return view(original, true);          // the retry, answered with the first order
  69                }
  70            }
  71            throw refusal(refused.rejection());
  72        }
  73
  74        RiskEngine.Preview now = brokerage.risk().preview(ticket);
  75        if (!now.canPlace()) {
  76            throw ToolFailure.of(ErrorCode.PRECONDITION_FAILED,
  77                    "The order can no longer be placed: " + now.blockers().getFirst().message(),
  78                    "Tell the customer what changed since they approved it, then call "
  79                            + "brokerage_order_preview again if they still want to trade.");
  80        }
  81        return view(brokerage.orders().place(ticket, idempotencyKey(token)), false);
  82    }
  83
  84    /** The key the order book is written under, derived from the token rather than from the model. */
  85    private static String idempotencyKey(String token) {
  86        return "place:" + token;
  87    }
  88
  89    private static ToolFailure refusal(ConfirmationTokens.Rejection rejection) {
  90        ErrorCode code = switch (rejection) {
  91            case EXPIRED, SPENT -> ErrorCode.CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED;
  92            case CHANGED -> ErrorCode.INVALID_ARGUMENT;
  93            case UNKNOWN, WRONG_PRINCIPAL -> ErrorCode.NOT_ENTITLED;
  94        };
  95        String remediation = switch (rejection) {
  96            case CHANGED -> "Call brokerage_order_preview with the terms the customer actually "
  97                    + "wants, show them the new estimate, and place that.";
  98            case EXPIRED, SPENT -> "Call brokerage_order_preview again, read the fresh estimate to "
  99                    + "the customer, and place the order only if they agree again.";
 100            case UNKNOWN, WRONG_PRINCIPAL -> "Do not retry. Tell the customer the confirmation "
 101                    + "could not be verified and start the order again from a preview.";
 102        };
 103        return ToolFailure.of(code, rejection.explanation(), remediation);
 104    }
 105
 106    private static Payload view(Orders.Order order, boolean duplicate) {
 107        return new Payload(order.orderId(), order.accountId(), order.symbol(),
 108                order.side().name(), order.quantity(), order.filledQuantity(),
 109                order.status().name(),
 110                order.averageFillPrice() == null ? null : Money.price(order.averageFillPrice()),
 111                Money.string(order.commission()), order.rejectReason(), duplicate,
 112                order.placedAt());
 113    }
 114}

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog.handlers;
   2
   3import java.time.Instant;
   4import java.util.List;
   5
   6import com.example.brokerage.domain.Accounts;
   7import com.example.brokerage.domain.Brokerage;
   8import com.example.brokerage.domain.ConfirmationTokens;
   9import com.example.brokerage.domain.Money;
  10import com.example.brokerage.domain.Orders;
  11import com.example.brokerage.domain.RiskEngine;
  12import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.Invocation;
  13import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolFailure;
  14import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolHandler;
  15
  16import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  17
  18/**
  19 * {@code brokerage_order_preview}. The most important tool in the catalog.
  20 *
  21 * <p>Everything safe about this catalog is built on one property of this handler: it issues a
  22 * {@code confirmationToken}, and nothing else does. The token is bound to the ticket's fingerprint
  23 * and to the session, is single-use, and expires in two minutes. Because
  24 * {@code brokerage_order_place} and {@code brokerage_order_replace} require one, an agent
  25 * physically cannot trade without first pricing the trade, and cannot trade terms that differ by
  26 * so much as a cent from the ones the customer was shown.
  27 *
  28 * <p>Note the token is only issued when {@code canPlace} is true. A refused order has nothing to
  29 * approve, and handing back a token "just in case" would let an agent carry authority past the
  30 * reason it was refused.
  31 *
  32 * <p>Note also that this handler is read-only. It is a tier 1 tool rather than tier 0 because it
  33 * reaches the risk and margin engines and because minting authority is not nothing, but it changes
  34 * no state a customer can observe, which is why the descriptor can honestly tell the model to call
  35 * it as often as it likes while the customer adjusts the order.
  36 */
  37@Component
  38public class OrderPreviewHandler implements ToolHandler {
  39
  40    record BlockerView(String code, String message, Long maxPermissibleQuantity) {
  41    }
  42
  43    record EstimateView(String referencePrice, String estimatedPrincipal, String commission,
  44                        String estimatedCost, String buyingPowerBefore, String buyingPowerAfter,
  45                        String currency, boolean isEstimate) {
  46    }
  47
  48    record Payload(boolean canPlace, List<BlockerView> blockers, List<String> warnings,
  49                   EstimateView estimate, String confirmationToken, Instant expiresAt,
  50                   String summary, String session, Instant asOf) {
  51    }
  52
  53    private final Brokerage brokerage;
  54    private final AccountGuard guard;
  55    private final Tickets tickets;
  56
  57    public OrderPreviewHandler(Brokerage brokerage, AccountGuard guard, Tickets tickets) {
  58        this.brokerage = brokerage;
  59        this.guard = guard;
  60        this.tickets = tickets;
  61    }
  62
  63    @Override
  64    public String name() {
  65        return "brokerage_order_preview";
  66    }
  67
  68    @Override
  69    public Object handle(Invocation invocation) {
  70        Accounts.Account account = guard.requireTradeable(invocation);
  71        Orders.Ticket ticket = tickets.from(invocation, account.accountId());
  72        String replaces = invocation.string("replacesOrderId");
  73        if (replaces != null) {
  74            ticket = asAmendmentOf(requireWorking(account, replaces), ticket);
  75        }
  76        RiskEngine.Preview preview = brokerage.risk().preview(ticket);
  77
  78        ConfirmationTokens.Issued issued = null;
  79        if (preview.canPlace()) {
  80            issued = brokerage.confirmations().issue(fingerprintOf(ticket, replaces),
  81                    invocation.principal().sessionId());
  82        }
  83        return new Payload(preview.canPlace(),
  84                preview.blockers().stream().map(OrderPreviewHandler::view).toList(),
  85                preview.warnings(), view(preview.estimate()),
  86                issued == null ? null : issued.token(),
  87                issued == null ? null : issued.expiresAt(),
  88                preview.summary(), brokerage.clock().session().name(), brokerage.clock().now());
  89    }
  90
  91    /**
  92     * The fingerprint a replacement's token is bound to includes the order being replaced, so a
  93     * token minted for "move ord_A to 500" cannot be spent on ord_B.
  94     */
  95    static Orders.Ticket fingerprintOf(Orders.Ticket ticket, String replacesOrderId) {
  96        if (replacesOrderId == null) {
  97            return ticket;
  98        }
  99        return new Orders.Ticket(ticket.accountId() + "/" + replacesOrderId, ticket.symbol(),
 100                ticket.side(), ticket.quantity(), ticket.orderType(), ticket.limitPrice(),
 101                ticket.stopPrice(), ticket.timeInForce(), ticket.extendedHours());
 102    }
 103
 104    private Orders.Order requireWorking(Accounts.Account account, String orderId) {
 105        Orders.Order order = brokerage.orders().find(orderId)
 106                .filter(found -> found.accountId().equals(account.accountId()))
 107                .orElseThrow(() -> ToolFailure.notFound("Order " + orderId,
 108                        "Call brokerage_orders_list for this account and use an orderId from it."));
 109        if (order.status().terminal()) {
 110            throw ToolFailure.precondition(
 111                    "Order " + orderId + " is already " + order.status()
 112                            + " and cannot be changed.",
 113                    "Tell the customer the order has finished, and read it back to them with "
 114                            + "brokerage_order_get if they want the details.");
 115        }
 116        return order;
 117    }
 118
 119    /**
 120     * Rebuild the ticket as an amendment of a live order.
 121     *
 122     * <p>An amendment can change quantity, limit price and stop price. It cannot change side,
 123     * order type or time in force; those are properties of the order and a request to change one
 124     * is a request to cancel and re-enter. So they are taken from the order rather than from the
 125     * arguments, and a conflicting argument is an error rather than a silent reinterpretation.
 126     *
 127     * <p>This is also what keeps the fingerprint honest. {@code brokerage_order_replace} builds
 128     * its ticket from the order's own attributes, so if this handler took the time in force from
 129     * the arguments instead, a preview of a good-till-canceled order would mint a token the
 130     * replace tool could never spend — and the failure would surface as "the order does not match
 131     * the one that was confirmed", which is true and completely unhelpful.
 132     */
 133    private static Orders.Ticket asAmendmentOf(Orders.Order order, Orders.Ticket requested) {
 134        conflict("side", order.side().name(), requested.side().name());
 135        conflict("orderType", order.orderType().name(), requested.orderType().name());
 136        return new Orders.Ticket(requested.accountId(), order.symbol(), order.side(),
 137                requested.quantity(), order.orderType(), requested.limitPrice(),
 138                requested.stopPrice(), order.timeInForce(), requested.extendedHours());
 139    }
 140
 141    private static void conflict(String field, String onTheOrder, String requested) {
 142        if (!onTheOrder.equals(requested)) {
 143            throw ToolFailure.invalidArgument(
 144                    "That order's " + field + " is " + onTheOrder + " and an amendment cannot "
 145                            + "change it to " + requested + ".",
 146                    "Cancel the order with brokerage_order_cancel and place a new one, if that is "
 147                            + "what the customer wants. Tell them that is what it takes.");
 148        }
 149    }
 150
 151    private static BlockerView view(RiskEngine.Blocker blocker) {
 152        return new BlockerView(blocker.code(), blocker.message(),
 153                blocker.maxPermissibleQuantity());
 154    }
 155
 156    private static EstimateView view(RiskEngine.Estimate estimate) {
 157        return new EstimateView(Money.price(estimate.referencePrice()),
 158                Money.string(estimate.estimatedPrincipal()), Money.string(estimate.commission()),
 159                Money.string(estimate.estimatedCost()), Money.string(estimate.buyingPowerBefore()),
 160                Money.string(estimate.buyingPowerAfter()), estimate.currency(),
 161                estimate.isEstimate());
 162    }
 163}

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog.handlers;
   2
   3import java.math.BigDecimal;
   4import java.time.Instant;
   5
   6import com.example.brokerage.domain.Accounts;
   7import com.example.brokerage.domain.Brokerage;
   8import com.example.brokerage.domain.ConfirmationTokens;
   9import com.example.brokerage.domain.Money;
  10import com.example.brokerage.domain.Orders;
  11import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ErrorCode;
  12import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.Invocation;
  13import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolFailure;
  14import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolHandler;
  15
  16import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  17
  18/**
  19 * {@code brokerage_order_replace}.
  20 *
  21 * <p>Tier 3, the same as placing, and the reason is worth saying to anyone who objects. Raising a
  22 * limit from 495 to 512 and buying at 512 are the same economic act; the customer's exposure
  23 * changes by exactly the same amount either way. A catalog that treats amendment as a lesser
  24 * operation has given the agent a cheaper route to the same outcome, and cheaper routes get used.
  25 *
  26 * <p>The {@code replaced: false} path is the one that needs care. An order can fill between the
  27 * customer agreeing to a change and the venue acting on it. When that happens nothing was amended,
  28 * the original terms are what executed, and the honest answer is a successful call reporting that.
  29 * Returning an error here would be wrong twice over: nothing failed, and an agent that sees an
  30 * error will retry.
  31 */
  32@Component
  33public class OrderReplaceHandler implements ToolHandler {
  34
  35    record Payload(boolean replaced, String orderId, String symbol, String side, long quantity,
  36                   long filledQuantity, String limitPrice, String stopPrice, String status,
  37                   String explanation, Instant updatedAt) {
  38    }
  39
  40    private final Brokerage brokerage;
  41    private final AccountGuard guard;
  42
  43    public OrderReplaceHandler(Brokerage brokerage, AccountGuard guard) {
  44        this.brokerage = brokerage;
  45        this.guard = guard;
  46    }
  47
  48    @Override
  49    public String name() {
  50        return "brokerage_order_replace";
  51    }
  52
  53    @Override
  54    public Object handle(Invocation invocation) {
  55        Accounts.Account account = guard.requireTradeable(invocation);
  56        String orderId = invocation.string("orderId");
  57        Orders.Order order = brokerage.orders().find(orderId)
  58                .filter(found -> found.accountId().equals(account.accountId()))
  59                .orElseThrow(() -> ToolFailure.notFound("Order " + orderId,
  60                        "Call brokerage_orders_list for this account and use an orderId from it."));
  61
  62        long quantity = invocation.integer("quantity");
  63        BigDecimal limit = Tickets.decimal(invocation, "limitPrice");
  64        BigDecimal stop = Tickets.decimal(invocation, "stopPrice");
  65        String token = invocation.string("confirmationToken");
  66
  67        Orders.Ticket proposed = OrderPreviewHandler.fingerprintOf(
  68                new Orders.Ticket(account.accountId(), order.symbol(), order.side(), quantity,
  69                        order.orderType(), limit, stop, order.timeInForce(), false),
  70                orderId);
  71        ConfirmationTokens.Redemption redemption = brokerage.confirmations()
  72                .redeem(token, proposed, invocation.principal().sessionId());
  73        if (redemption instanceof ConfirmationTokens.Redemption.Refused refused) {
  74            throw ToolFailure.of(
  75                    refused.rejection() == ConfirmationTokens.Rejection.CHANGED
  76                            ? ErrorCode.INVALID_ARGUMENT : ErrorCode.CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED,
  77                    refused.rejection().explanation(),
  78                    "Call brokerage_order_preview with replacesOrderId set to " + orderId
  79                            + " and the terms the customer wants, show them the estimate, and try "
  80                            + "again only if they agree.");
  81        }
  82
  83        if (order.status().terminal()) {
  84            return new Payload(false, order.orderId(), order.symbol(), order.side().name(),
  85                    order.quantity(), order.filledQuantity(),
  86                    order.limitPrice() == null ? null : Money.price(order.limitPrice()),
  87                    order.stopPrice() == null ? null : Money.price(order.stopPrice()),
  88                    order.status().name(),
  89                    "The order was already " + order.status() + " before the change reached the "
  90                            + "venue, so nothing was amended and the original terms are what "
  91                            + "happened. Tell the customer that, and read the order back to them "
  92                            + "if they want the detail.",
  93                    order.updatedAt());
  94        }
  95        if (quantity < order.filledQuantity()) {
  96            throw ToolFailure.invalidArgument(
  97                    "The order has already filled " + order.filledQuantity()
  98                            + " shares, so it cannot be reduced to " + quantity + ".",
  99                    "Offer the customer a quantity of at least " + order.filledQuantity()
 100                            + ", or cancel the remainder with brokerage_order_cancel.");
 101        }
 102
 103        Orders.Order updated = brokerage.orders()
 104                .replace(orderId, quantity, limit, stop)
 105                .orElseThrow(() -> ToolFailure.of(ErrorCode.CONFLICT,
 106                        "The order changed while the amendment was in flight.",
 107                        "Call brokerage_order_get for " + orderId + " to see where it stands, and "
 108                                + "tell the customer before trying anything else."));
 109        return new Payload(true, updated.orderId(), updated.symbol(), updated.side().name(),
 110                updated.quantity(), updated.filledQuantity(),
 111                updated.limitPrice() == null ? null : Money.price(updated.limitPrice()),
 112                updated.stopPrice() == null ? null : Money.price(updated.stopPrice()),
 113                updated.status().name(),
 114                "The order was amended and keeps the identifier " + updated.orderId() + ".",
 115                updated.updatedAt());
 116    }
 117}

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog.handlers;
   2
   3import java.time.Instant;
   4import java.util.List;
   5import java.util.function.Predicate;
   6
   7import com.example.brokerage.domain.Accounts;
   8import com.example.brokerage.domain.Brokerage;
   9import com.example.brokerage.domain.Money;
  10import com.example.brokerage.domain.Orders;
  11import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.Invocation;
  12import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolHandler;
  13
  14import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  15
  16/**
  17 * {@code brokerage_orders_list}.
  18 *
  19 * <p>The default for {@code state} is {@code WORKING}, and the default is the design. "Do I have
  20 * any orders open" is the question nine times in ten, and a tool whose default answer is six
  21 * months of history makes the model pay for the other one and then summarize the wrong thing.
  22 * Defaults in a tool schema are not conveniences; they are the behavior you get.
  23 *
  24 * <p>Pagination is an opaque forward cursor, never a page number. The order book moves while the
  25 * agent reads it: page two of an offset-paginated list can repeat a row or skip one, and the agent
  26 * will report whatever it was handed. A cursor that encodes a position in a stable ordering cannot
  27 * do that.
  28 */
  29@Component
  30public class OrdersListHandler implements ToolHandler {
  31
  32    record OrderView(String orderId, String symbol, String side, long quantity,
  33                     long filledQuantity, String orderType, String limitPrice, String stopPrice,
  34                     String timeInForce, String status, String averageFillPrice,
  35                     String rejectReason, Instant placedAt, Instant updatedAt) {
  36    }
  37
  38    record Payload(String accountId, List<OrderView> orders, String nextCursor, Instant asOf) {
  39    }
  40
  41    private final Brokerage brokerage;
  42    private final AccountGuard guard;
  43
  44    public OrdersListHandler(Brokerage brokerage, AccountGuard guard) {
  45        this.brokerage = brokerage;
  46        this.guard = guard;
  47    }
  48
  49    @Override
  50    public String name() {
  51        return "brokerage_orders_list";
  52    }
  53
  54    @Override
  55    public Object handle(Invocation invocation) {
  56        Accounts.Account account = guard.require(invocation);
  57        String state = invocation.string("state", "WORKING");
  58        String symbol = invocation.string("symbol");
  59        int limit = invocation.integer("limit", 20);
  60
  61        Predicate<Orders.Order> byState = switch (state) {
  62            case "TERMINAL" -> order -> order.status().terminal();
  63            case "ALL" -> order -> true;
  64            default -> order -> order.status().working();
  65        };
  66        Predicate<Orders.Order> bySymbol = order -> symbol == null || order.symbol().equals(symbol);
  67        List<Orders.Order> all = brokerage.orders().of(account.accountId(), byState.and(bySymbol));
  68
  69        int from = Cursors.offset(invocation.string("cursor"));
  70        List<Orders.Order> page = all.stream().skip(from).limit(limit).toList();
  71        String next = from + page.size() < all.size()
  72                ? Cursors.encode(from + page.size()) : null;
  73        return new Payload(account.accountId(),
  74                page.stream().map(OrdersListHandler::view).toList(), next,
  75                brokerage.clock().now());
  76    }
  77
  78    static OrderView view(Orders.Order order) {
  79        return new OrderView(order.orderId(), order.symbol(), order.side().name(),
  80                order.quantity(), order.filledQuantity(), order.orderType().name(),
  81                order.limitPrice() == null ? null : Money.price(order.limitPrice()),
  82                order.stopPrice() == null ? null : Money.price(order.stopPrice()),
  83                order.timeInForce().name(), order.status().name(),
  84                order.averageFillPrice() == null ? null : Money.price(order.averageFillPrice()),
  85                order.rejectReason(), order.placedAt(), order.updatedAt());
  86    }
  87}

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog.handlers;

   3import java.math.BigDecimal;

   8import com.example.brokerage.domain.Accounts;
   9import com.example.brokerage.domain.Brokerage;
