  33import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ToolHandler;
  34import com.example.brokerage.tooling.runtime.ApprovalGate;
  35import com.example.brokerage.tooling.runtime.AuditLog;
  36import com.example.brokerage.tooling.runtime.InvocationPipeline;
  37import com.example.brokerage.tooling.runtime.KillSwitches;
  38import com.example.brokerage.tooling.runtime.RateLimiter;
  39import com.example.brokerage.tooling.runtime.ToolRegistry;
  40
  41import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
  42
  43/**
  44 * The whole catalog, wired by hand, with no Spring and no network.
  45 *
  46 * <p>These are the identifiers the seeded book of business always has. They are constants rather
  47 * than lookups because a test that first calls {@code brokerage_accounts_list} to find out which
  48 * account to use is testing two things, and when it fails you do not know which.
  49 */
  50class CatalogFixture {
  51
  52    static final String MARGIN_ACCOUNT = "acct_4RZ61FZAD0RMHNMM";
  53    static final String CASH_ACCOUNT = "acct_2GDR417WM0WF031F";
  54    static final String ROTH_ACCOUNT = "acct_TF7KNH2A136X695X";
  55    static final String FROZEN_ACCOUNT = "acct_V5WR2E9BFKVE7J8F";
  56    static final String WORKING_MSFT_ORDER = "ord_CZ9R91DVFPMN5BX0";
  57    static final String FILLED_NVDA_ORDER = "ord_M07KB16SEA01HW70";
  58
  59    static final Set<String> READ_SCOPES = Set.of("brokerage:reference:read",
  60            "brokerage:market-data:read", "brokerage:accounts:read", "brokerage:balances:read",
  61            "brokerage:positions:read", "brokerage:orders:read");
  62
  63    final MarketClock clock = new MarketClock();
  64    final Brokerage brokerage;
  65    final BrokerageCatalog catalog = new BrokerageCatalog();
  66    final ToolRegistry registry;
  67    final ApprovalGate approvals = new ApprovalGate();
  68    final AuditLog audit = new AuditLog();
  69    final KillSwitches switches = new KillSwitches();
  70    final InvocationPipeline pipeline;
  71
  72    CatalogFixture() {
  73        Instruments instruments = new Instruments();
  74        MarketData marketData = new MarketData(instruments, clock);
  75        Accounts accounts = new Accounts(instruments, marketData, clock);
  76        Orders orders = new Orders(clock, marketData);
  77        RiskEngine risk = new RiskEngine(accounts, instruments, marketData, clock, orders);
  78        ConfirmationTokens confirmations = new ConfirmationTokens(clock);
  79        brokerage = new Brokerage(accounts, instruments, marketData, orders, risk, confirmations,
  80                clock);
  81
  82        AccountGuard guard = new AccountGuard(brokerage);
  83        Tickets tickets = new Tickets(brokerage);
  84        List<ToolHandler> handlers = List.of(
  85                new AccountsListHandler(brokerage),
  86                new InstrumentsSearchHandler(brokerage),
  87                new QuotesGetHandler(brokerage),
  88                new PriceHistoryGetHandler(brokerage),
  89                new BalancesGetHandler(brokerage, guard),
  90                new PositionsListHandler(brokerage, guard),
  91                new TaxLotsListHandler(brokerage, guard),
  92                new OrdersListHandler(brokerage, guard),
  93                new OrderGetHandler(brokerage, guard),
  94                new ExecutionsListHandler(brokerage, guard),
  95                new OrderPreviewHandler(brokerage, guard, tickets),
  96                new OrderPlaceHandler(brokerage, guard, tickets),
  97                new OrderReplaceHandler(brokerage, guard),
  98                new OrderCancelHandler(brokerage, guard));
  99        registry = new ToolRegistry(catalog.ontology(), catalog.descriptors(), handlers);
 100        pipeline = new InvocationPipeline(registry, approvals, new RateLimiter(), switches, audit,
 101                new BrokerageApprovalContext(brokerage), clock::now);
 102    }
 103
 104    Principal reader() {
 105        return new Principal("test:reader", Accounts.DEMO_CUSTOMER, READ_SCOPES, "session-read");
 106    }
 107
 108    Principal trader() {
 109        Set<String> scopes = new java.util.LinkedHashSet<>(READ_SCOPES);
 110        scopes.add("brokerage:orders:write");
 111        return new Principal("test:trader", Accounts.DEMO_CUSTOMER, scopes, "session-trade");
 112    }
 113
 114    /** Call a tool and return the payload, failing the test if the envelope was not ok. */
 115    JsonNode data(String tool, String arguments, Principal principal) {
 116        InvocationPipeline.Outcome outcome = pipeline.invoke(tool, arguments, principal);
 117        if (!outcome.ok()) {
 118            throw new AssertionError(tool + " failed: " + outcome.json());
 119        }
 120        return DescriptorCodec.tree(outcome.json()).path("data");
 121    }
 122
 123    InvocationPipeline.Outcome call(String tool, String arguments, Principal principal) {
 124        return pipeline.invoke(tool, arguments, principal);
 125    }
 126
 127    JsonNode error(String tool, String arguments, Principal principal) {
 128        return DescriptorCodec.tree(pipeline.invoke(tool, arguments, principal).json())
 129                .path("error");
 130    }
 131
 132    /** Stand in for the customer saying yes, then call again with the identical arguments. */
 133    InvocationPipeline.Outcome callWithApproval(String tool, String arguments,
 134                                                Principal principal) {
 135        InvocationPipeline.Outcome first = pipeline.invoke(tool, arguments, principal);
 136        if (first.approvalReference() == null) {
 137            return first;
 138        }
 139        approvals.grant(first.approvalReference(), "test-customer", clock.now());
 140        return pipeline.invoke(tool, arguments, principal);
 141    }
 142
 143    void moveClockTo(String instant) {
 144        clock.set(Instant.parse(instant));
 145    }
 146}

  11import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

  13/**
  14 * What each read tool promises, checked against what it returns.
  15 *
  16 * <p>Every payload in here has already been validated against its own output schema by the
  17 * pipeline, so these tests are not re-checking the shape. They check the <em>claims the
  18 * description makes</em> — that buying power is net of reserved cash, that positions come back
  19 * largest first, that a lot knows its holding period — because those are the claims the model is
  20 * acting on and no schema can express them.
  21 */
  22class HandlerContractTest {
  23
  24    private CatalogFixture fixture;
  25
  26    @BeforeEach
  27    void setUp() {
  28        fixture = new CatalogFixture();
  29    }
  30
  31    @Test
  32    @DisplayName("accounts come back with the customer's four accounts and the frozen one flagged")
  33    void accountsAreListedWithTheirRestrictions() {
  34        JsonNode data = fixture.data("brokerage_accounts_list", "{}", fixture.reader());
  35        assertThat(data.path("accounts").size()).isEqualTo(4);
  36        JsonNode frozen = data.path("accounts").values().stream()
  37                .filter(account -> account.path("accountId").asString()
  38                        .equals(CatalogFixture.FROZEN_ACCOUNT))
  39                .findFirst().orElseThrow();
  40        assertThat(frozen.path("tradeable").asBoolean()).isFalse();
  41        assertThat(frozen.path("restriction").asString()).isEqualTo("FROZEN");
  42        assertThat(frozen.path("type").asString()).isEqualTo("IRA_TRADITIONAL");
  43    }
  44
  45    @Test
  46    @DisplayName("an account belonging to someone else is NOT_FOUND, never NOT_ENTITLED")
  47    void anotherCustomersAccountIsIndistinguishableFromAMadeUpOne() {
  48        JsonNode error = fixture.error("brokerage_balances_get",
  49                "{\"accountId\":\"acct_ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ\"}", fixture.reader());
  50        assertThat(error.path("code").asString()).isEqualTo(ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND.name());
  51        assertThat(error.path("remediation").asString()).contains("brokerage_accounts_list");
  52    }
  53
  54    @Test
  55    @DisplayName("buying power is net of the cash already committed to working orders")
  56    void buyingPowerIsNetOfReservedCash() {
  57        JsonNode data = fixture.data("brokerage_balances_get",
  58                "{\"accountId\":\"" + CatalogFixture.MARGIN_ACCOUNT + "\"}", fixture.reader());
  59        assertThat(new java.math.BigDecimal(data.path("cashReservedForOrders").asString()))
  60                .as("the seeded account has two working buy orders")
  61                .isGreaterThan(java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO);
  62        assertThat(data.path("marginLoan").asString()).isEqualTo("24000.00");
  63        assertThat(data.path("dayTradesUsed").asInt()).isEqualTo(2);
  64    }
  65
  66    @Test
  67    @DisplayName("a cash account's buying power never exceeds its settled cash")
  68    void cashAccountsCannotBorrow() {
  69        JsonNode data = fixture.data("brokerage_balances_get",
  70                "{\"accountId\":\"" + CatalogFixture.CASH_ACCOUNT + "\"}", fixture.reader());
  71        assertThat(new java.math.BigDecimal(data.path("buyingPower").asString()))
  72                .isLessThanOrEqualTo(new java.math.BigDecimal(data.path("settledCash").asString()));
  73        assertThat(data.path("marginLoan").asString()).isEqualTo("0.00");
  74    }
  75
  76    @Test
  77    @DisplayName("positions come back largest first, with the weight already computed")
  78    void positionsArePrioritizedAndPreComputed() {
  79        JsonNode data = fixture.data("brokerage_positions_list",
  80                "{\"accountId\":\"" + CatalogFixture.MARGIN_ACCOUNT + "\"}", fixture.reader());
  81        var values = data.path("positions").values().stream().toList();
  82        assertThat(values).hasSize(5);
  83        java.math.BigDecimal previous = null;
  84        for (JsonNode position : values) {
  85            java.math.BigDecimal value = new java.math.BigDecimal(
  86                    position.path("marketValue").asString());
  87            if (previous != null) {
  88                assertThat(value).as("positions must be ordered by value, largest first")
  89                        .isLessThanOrEqualTo(previous);
  90            }
  91            previous = value;
  92            assertThat(position.path("portfolioWeight").asString()).isNotBlank();
  93        }
  94    }
  95
  96    @Test
  97    @DisplayName("quotes are batched, and a symbol that does not resolve is named rather than dropped")
  98    void unresolvedSymbolsAreNamed() {
  99        JsonNode data = fixture.data("brokerage_quotes_get",
 100                "{\"symbols\":[\"AAPL\",\"BRK.B\",\"ZZZZ\"]}", fixture.reader());
 101        assertThat(data.path("quotes").size()).isEqualTo(2);
 102        assertThat(data.path("unresolved").values().stream()
 103                .map(JsonNode::asString).toList()).containsExactly("ZZZZ");
 104        assertThat(data.path("session").asString()).isEqualTo("REGULAR");
 105    }
 106
 107    @Test
 108    @DisplayName("a share class with a dot in its ticker is quotable")
 109    void theSymbolPatternAllowsSharpClasses() {
 110        JsonNode data = fixture.data("brokerage_quotes_get", "{\"symbols\":[\"BRK.B\"]}",
 111                fixture.reader());
 112        assertThat(data.path("quotes").path(0).path("symbol").asString()).isEqualTo("BRK.B");
 113    }
 114
 115    @Test
 116    @DisplayName("a free-text search returns candidates and refuses to choose")
 117    void searchReturnsCandidatesRatherThanAnAnswer() {
 118        JsonNode data = fixture.data("brokerage_instruments_search",
 119                "{\"query\":\"Apple\"}", fixture.reader());
 120        assertThat(data.path("exactMatch").asBoolean()).isFalse();
 121        assertThat(data.path("candidates").values().stream()
 122                .map(candidate -> candidate.path("symbol").asString()).toList())
 123                .as("both Apple Inc. and Apple Hospitality match the word")
 124                .contains("AAPL", "APLE");
 125    }
 126
 127    @Test
 128    @DisplayName("an exact ticker is reported as an exact match, so the agent need not ask")
 129    void anExactTickerNeedsNoQuestion() {
 130        JsonNode data = fixture.data("brokerage_instruments_search",
 131                "{\"query\":\"MSFT\"}", fixture.reader());
 132        assertThat(data.path("exactMatch").asBoolean()).isTrue();
 133        assertThat(data.path("candidates").size()).isEqualTo(1);
 134    }
 135
 136    @Test
 137    @DisplayName("price history carries its own summary, so the model does no arithmetic")
 138    void historyIsSummarizedForTheModel() {
 139        JsonNode data = fixture.data("brokerage_price_history_get",
 140                "{\"symbol\":\"NVDA\",\"days\":30}", fixture.reader());
 141        assertThat(data.path("bars").size()).isBetween(18, 24);
 142        assertThat(data.path("periodHigh").asString()).isNotBlank();
 143        assertThat(data.path("periodLow").asString()).isNotBlank();
 144        assertThat(data.path("totalReturnPercent").asString()).isNotBlank();

 146                .isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(

 148    }
 149
 150    @Test
 151    @DisplayName("tax lots know their holding period and their wash-sale exposure")
 152    void lotsCarryTheFactsATaxConversationNeeds() {
 153        JsonNode data = fixture.data("brokerage_tax_lots_list",
 154                "{\"accountId\":\"" + CatalogFixture.MARGIN_ACCOUNT + "\",\"symbol\":\"AAPL\"}",
 155                fixture.reader());
 156        assertThat(data.path("taxable").asBoolean()).isTrue();
 157        assertThat(data.path("defaultMethod").asString()).isEqualTo("FIFO");
 158        var lots = data.path("lots").values().stream().toList();

 160        assertThat(lots.getFirst().path("longTerm").asBoolean())

 163                .as("the 2026 lot is not").isFalse();
 164        assertThat(lots.getLast().path("washSaleRisk").asBoolean()).isTrue();

 167    @Test
 168    @DisplayName("a retirement account's lots say plainly that none of it is taxable")
 169    void lotsInARetirementAccountSaySo() {
 170        JsonNode data = fixture.data("brokerage_tax_lots_list",
 171                "{\"accountId\":\"" + CatalogFixture.ROTH_ACCOUNT + "\",\"symbol\":\"VOO\"}",

 181    void ordersDefaultToWorking() {

 193    void anOrderCarriesItsExecutions() {

   1package com.example.brokerage.catalog;
   2
   3import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.DescriptorCodec;
   4import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.ErrorCode;
   5import com.example.brokerage.tooling.contract.Principal;
   6import com.example.brokerage.tooling.runtime.InvocationPipeline;
   7
   8import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
   9import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
  10import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
  11
  12import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
  13
  14import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
  15
  16/**
  17 * The safety properties of the four tools that change something.
  18 *
  19 * <p>These are the tests that would be cited in a review, so each one states the property it
  20 * establishes rather than the mechanism it uses. Between them they say: an order cannot be placed
  21 * without being priced; cannot be placed on terms the customer did not see; cannot be placed
  22 * twice; cannot be placed in an account that may not trade; and a cancellation that lost a race
  23 * reports a fill rather than a cancellation.
  24 */
  25class TradingTrajectoryTest {
  26
  27    private static final String BUY_50_AAPL = """
  28            {"accountId":"%s","symbol":"AAPL","side":"BUY","quantity":50,"orderType":"MARKET"}"""
  29            .formatted(CatalogFixture.MARGIN_ACCOUNT);
  30
  31    private CatalogFixture fixture;
  32    private Principal trader;
  33
  34    @BeforeEach
  35    void setUp() {
  36        fixture = new CatalogFixture();
  37        trader = fixture.trader();
  38    }
  39
  40    private String previewToken(String arguments) {
  41        JsonNode data = fixture.data("brokerage_order_preview", arguments, trader);
  42        assertThat(data.path("canPlace").asBoolean())
  43                .as("preview should be placeable: %s", data).isTrue();
  44        return data.path("confirmationToken").asString();
  45    }
  46
  47    private static String place(String token) {
  48        return """
  49                {"accountId":"%s","symbol":"AAPL","side":"BUY","quantity":50,
  50                 "orderType":"MARKET","confirmationToken":"%s"}"""
  51                .formatted(CatalogFixture.MARGIN_ACCOUNT, token);
  52    }
  53
  54    @Test
  55    @DisplayName("an invented token does not become an order, even once a human has agreed")
  56    void placingNeedsATokenTheServiceIssued() {
  57        String arguments = place("cnf_AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA");
  58
  59        // The approval gate runs before the handler, so the first answer is about the human, not
  60        // about the token. That order matters: it means the gate never becomes an oracle for
  61        // whether a guessed token is real.
  62        InvocationPipeline.Outcome first = fixture.call("brokerage_order_place", arguments, trader);
  63        assertThat(first.errorCode()).isEqualTo(ErrorCode.APPROVAL_REQUIRED);
  64
  65        InvocationPipeline.Outcome approved = fixture.callWithApproval("brokerage_order_place",
  66                arguments, trader);
  67        assertThat(approved.errorCode()).isEqualTo(ErrorCode.NOT_ENTITLED);
  68        assertThat(DescriptorCodec.tree(approved.json()).path("error").path("remediation")
  69                .asString()).contains("Do not retry");
  70    }
  71
  72    @Test
  73    @DisplayName("a token with no approval behind it still stops at the gate")
  74    void aTokenIsNotAnApproval() {
  75        InvocationPipeline.Outcome outcome = fixture.call("brokerage_order_place",
  76                place(previewToken(BUY_50_AAPL)), trader);
  77        assertThat(outcome.errorCode()).isEqualTo(ErrorCode.APPROVAL_REQUIRED);
  78        assertThat(outcome.approvalReference()).isNotNull();
  79    }
  80
  81    @Test
  82    @DisplayName("the confirmation a human sees carries the priced cost, not just the arguments")
  83    void theConfirmationShowsTheMoney() {
  84        InvocationPipeline.Outcome outcome = fixture.call("brokerage_order_place",
  85                place(previewToken(BUY_50_AAPL)), trader);
  86        String summary = fixture.approvals.peek(outcome.approvalReference()).orElseThrow()
  87                .summary();
  88        assertThat(summary)
  89                .as("a dialog that says '(not given)' where the cost should be is how somebody "
  90                        + "approves an order they never saw the price of")
  91                .doesNotContain("(not given)")
  92                .contains("BUY", "50", "AAPL", "Everyday brokerage")
  93                .containsPattern("Estimated cost\\s+[0-9,]+\\.[0-9]{2} USD");
  94    }
  95
  96    @Test
  97    @DisplayName("preview, approve, place: the order fills and the account is changed")
  98    void theHappyPathWorks() {
  99        String arguments = place(previewToken(BUY_50_AAPL));
 100        InvocationPipeline.Outcome outcome = fixture.callWithApproval("brokerage_order_place",
 101                arguments, trader);
 102        assertThat(outcome.ok()).as("%s", outcome.json()).isTrue();
 103        JsonNode data = DescriptorCodec.tree(outcome.json()).path("data");
 104        assertThat(data.path("status").asString()).isEqualTo("FILLED");
 105        assertThat(data.path("filledQuantity").asInt()).isEqualTo(50);
 106        assertThat(data.path("duplicateOfPreviousCall").asBoolean()).isFalse();
 107        assertThat(data.path("orderId").asString()).matches("^ord_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{16}$");
 108    }
 109
 110    @Test
 111    @DisplayName("a retried place returns the original order rather than a second one")
 112    void aRetryDoesNotDoubleBook() {
 113        String arguments = place(previewToken(BUY_50_AAPL));
 114        InvocationPipeline.Outcome first = fixture.callWithApproval("brokerage_order_place",
 115                arguments, trader);
 116        String orderId = DescriptorCodec.tree(first.json()).path("data").path("orderId").asString();
 117
 118        // The retry needs its own approval, because the gate is single-use; the token is what
 119        // makes the second call idempotent rather than a second order.
 120        InvocationPipeline.Outcome second = fixture.callWithApproval("brokerage_order_place",
 121                arguments, trader);
 122        assertThat(second.ok()).as("%s", second.json()).isTrue();
 123        JsonNode data = DescriptorCodec.tree(second.json()).path("data");
 124        assertThat(data.path("orderId").asString())
 125                .as("the same ticket must come back as the same order")
 126                .isEqualTo(orderId);
 127        assertThat(data.path("duplicateOfPreviousCall").asBoolean())
 128                .as("and the agent must be told, so it describes one order and not two")
 129                .isTrue();
 130    }

 132    @Test

 257    @Test
 258    @DisplayName("cancelling needs no preview, and reports the order's real state")
 259    void cancellingIsItsOwnAsymmetry() {

 262                .formatted(CatalogFixture.MARGIN_ACCOUNT, CatalogFixture.WORKING_MSFT_ORDER);
 263        InvocationPipeline.Outcome outcome = fixture.callWithApproval("brokerage_order_cancel",

  16/**

  18 *
  19 * <p>No API key, no network, no chat. That is the point being made as much as the coverage being
  20 * bought: a tool catalog whose only entry point is a conversation is a catalog nobody can inspect,
  21 * test or review. Everything a reviewer needs — the descriptors, the ontology, the producer graph,
  22 * the generated briefing, the conformance report, and the ability to call any tool directly — is
  23 * reachable here with curl.

  10import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
  11import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
  12import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
  13import org.springframework.boot.SpringBootConfiguration;
  14import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
  15import org.springframework.context.annotation.ComponentScan;
  16import org.springframework.context.annotation.Import;
  17
  18import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
  19
  20import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
  21
  22/**
  23 * The desktop connector's protocol, driven one request at a time rather than through a pipe.
  24 *
  25 * <p>Two things are being asserted and they are different in kind. The first is that the manifest
  26 * is a <em>projection</em>: three fields and no more, so that nothing from the governance block can
  27 * leak into a model's context by accident. The second is that the connector is not a privileged
  28 * path — it goes through the same pipeline as everything else, which means a tier 3 tool
  29 * stops at the approval gate even here.
  30 */
  31@SpringBootTest(classes = BridgeProtocolTest.Context.class)
  32class BridgeProtocolTest {
  33
  34    /**
  35     * The protocol and what it needs, without the transport.
  36     *
  37     * <p>Booting {@code DesktopBridgeApplication} itself would start {@link BridgeLoop}, which
  38     * blocks reading standard input and hangs the suite — which is a fair argument that the
  39     * two belonged in separate classes in the first place.
  40     */
  41    @SpringBootConfiguration
  42    @ComponentScan(basePackages = {"com.example.brokerage.catalog", "com.example.brokerage.domain"})
  43    @Import(BridgeProtocol.class)
  44    static class Context {
  45    }
  46
  47    @Autowired
  48    BridgeProtocol bridge;
  49
  50    private static Principal principal(boolean trading) {
  51        return new Principal("test:desktop", Accounts.DEMO_CUSTOMER,
  52                BridgeProtocol.entitlements(trading), "desktop-test");
  53    }
  54
  55    private JsonNode call(String request, Principal who) {
  56        return DescriptorCodec.tree(DescriptorCodec.json(bridge.handle(request, who)));
  57    }
  58
  59    @Test
  60    @DisplayName("the manifest carries exactly name, description and input_schema")
  61    void theManifestIsAProjection() {
  62        List<Map<String, Object>> tools = bridge.manifest(principal(true));
  63        assertThat(tools).hasSize(14);
  64        for (Map<String, Object> tool : tools) {
  65            assertThat(tool.keySet())
  66                    .as("%s", tool.get("name"))
  67                    .containsExactly("name", "description", "input_schema");
  68        }
  69    }
  70
  71    @Test
  72    @DisplayName("nothing from the governance block reaches the model")
  73    void governanceDoesNotLeak() {
  74        String published = DescriptorCodec.json(bridge.manifest(principal(true)));
  75        assertThat(published)
  76                .doesNotContain("riskTier", "entitlements", "killSwitch", "retention",
  77                        "confirmationTemplate", "conformanceLevel", "outputSchema",
  78                        "readOnlyHint", "_meta");
  79    }
  80
  81    @Test
  82    @DisplayName("the trading flag is the only thing that changes what is published")
  83    void theFlagDecidesTheCatalog() {
  84        assertThat(bridge.manifest(principal(false))).hasSize(10);
  85        assertThat(bridge.manifest(principal(true))).hasSize(14);
  86    }
  87
  88    @Test
  89    @DisplayName("list_tools hands over the manifest, the briefing and the conduct prompt")
  90    void listToolsCarriesEverythingASessionNeeds() {
  91        JsonNode response = call("""
  92                {"id":1,"method":"list_tools"}""", principal(false));
  93        assertThat(response.path("id").asInt()).isEqualTo(1);
  94        assertThat(response.path("result").path("tools").size()).isEqualTo(10);
  95        assertThat(response.path("result").path("briefing").asString())
  96                .contains("Identifiers you cannot invent");
  97        assertThat(response.path("result").path("conduct").asString())
  98                .contains("You do not give investment advice");
  99    }
 100
 101    @Test
 102    @DisplayName("call_tool goes through the pipeline and returns the envelope")
 103    void callToolReturnsAnEnvelope() {
 104        JsonNode response = call("""
 105                {"id":2,"method":"call_tool","params":{"name":"brokerage_quotes_get",
 106                 "arguments":{"symbols":["AAPL","BRK.B"]}}}""", principal(false));
 107        JsonNode result = response.path("result");
 108        assertThat(result.path("ok").asBoolean()).isTrue();
 109        assertThat(result.path("data").path("quotes").size()).isEqualTo(2);
 110        assertThat(result.path("meta").path("requestId").asString()).startsWith("req_");
 111    }
 112
 113    @Test
 114    @DisplayName("the same schema validation applies here as anywhere else")
 115    void theConnectorIsNotABackDoor() {
 116        JsonNode response = call("""
 117                {"id":3,"method":"call_tool","params":{"name":"brokerage_quotes_get",
 118                 "arguments":{"symbols":["not a ticker"]}}}""", principal(false));
 119        assertThat(response.path("result").path("error").path("code").asString())
 120                .isEqualTo("INVALID_ARGUMENT");
 121    }
 122
 123    @Test
 124    @DisplayName("a read-only session cannot see the trading tools at all")
 125    void readOnlySessionsCannotTrade() {
 126        JsonNode response = call("""
 127                {"id":4,"method":"call_tool","params":{"name":"brokerage_order_cancel",
 128                 "arguments":{"accountId":"acct_4RZ61FZAD0RMHNMM",
 129                              "orderId":"ord_CZ9R91DVFPMN5BX0"}}}""", principal(false));
 130        assertThat(response.path("result").path("error").path("code").asString())
 131                .isEqualTo("UNKNOWN_TOOL");
 132    }
 133
 134    @Test
 135    @DisplayName("a trading session still stops at the approval gate, and the gate can be answered")
 136    void theApprovalLoopCloses() {
 137        Principal trader = principal(true);
 138        String cancel = """
 139                {"id":5,"method":"call_tool","params":{"name":"brokerage_order_cancel",
 140                 "arguments":{"accountId":"acct_4RZ61FZAD0RMHNMM",
 141                              "orderId":"ord_CZ9R91DVFPMN5BX0"}}}""";
 142
 143        JsonNode first = call(cancel, trader);
 144        assertThat(first.path("result").path("error").path("code").asString())
 145                .isEqualTo("APPROVAL_REQUIRED");
 146        String reference = first.path("result").path("error").path("approvalReference").asString();
 147        assertThat(reference).startsWith("apr_");
 148
 149        JsonNode pending = call("""
 150                {"id":6,"method":"pending_approvals"}""", trader);
 151        assertThat(pending.path("result").path("pending").size()).isEqualTo(1);
 152        assertThat(pending.path("result").path("pending").path(0).path("summary").asString())
 153                .as("the person at the desktop has to see what they are agreeing to")
 154                .doesNotContain("(not given)")
 155                .contains("MSFT");
 156
 157        call("{\"id\":7,\"method\":\"approve\",\"params\":{\"reference\":\"" + reference + "\"}}",
 158                trader);
 159
 160        JsonNode second = call(cancel, trader);
 161        assertThat(second.path("result").path("ok").asBoolean()).isTrue();
 162        assertThat(second.path("result").path("data").path("cancelled").asBoolean()).isTrue();
 163    }
 164
 165    @Test
 166    @DisplayName("an unknown method lists the ones that exist, rather than failing silently")
 167    void unknownMethodsAreHelpful() {
 168        JsonNode response = call("""
 169                {"id":8,"method":"sell_everything"}""", principal(true));
 170        assertThat(response.path("error").path("code").asString()).isEqualTo("UNKNOWN_METHOD");
 171        assertThat(DescriptorCodec.json(response)).contains("list_tools", "call_tool", "approve");
 172    }
 173
 174    @Test
 175    @DisplayName("a line that is not JSON does not take the connector down")
 176    void malformedInputIsSurvivable() {
 177        JsonNode response = call("this is not json", principal(false));
 178        assertThat(response.path("error").path("code").asString()).isEqualTo("BAD_REQUEST");
 179    }
 180}

test-harness/src/test/java/com/example/brokerage/harness/EvaluationSuiteTest.java136 lines

   1package com.example.brokerage.harness;
   2
   3import java.io.IOException;
   4import java.nio.file.Files;
   5import java.nio.file.Path;
   6import java.util.ArrayList;
   7import java.util.List;
   8import java.util.stream.Stream;
   9
  10import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
  11import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
  12import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
  13import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.MethodSource;
  14
  15import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
  16
  17/**
  18 * The evaluation suites, as part of the ordinary build.
  19 *
  20 * <p>This is the test that makes the harness worth having. An agent suite that runs when somebody
  21 * remembers to run it is documentation; one that runs on every commit is a gate. It runs offline
  22 * from the cassettes, which is what makes that possible: no key, no network, no bill, and
  23 * deterministic.
  24 *
  25 * <p>What it still catches, despite the model's half being a recording, is most of what actually
  26 * changes. Narrow a pattern and the recorded arguments stop validating. Rename an output field and
  27 * the payload stops matching its schema. Raise a risk tier and a scenario that used to reach a
  28 * tool now stops at the gate. Drop the approval requirement and the refusal suite notices.
  29 *
  30 * <p>What it cannot catch is a change to a description, because the model's reading of the
  31 * description is what was recorded. {@link #cassettesAreAccountedFor()} keeps that honest by
  32 * failing if a scenario has no recording at all, and the suite reports which recordings are
  33 * authored rather than captured.
  34 */
  35class EvaluationSuiteTest {
  36
  37    private static final Path SUITES = Path.of("src/main/resources/evals");
  38    private static final Path CASSETTES = Path.of("src/main/resources/cassettes");
  39
  40    static Stream<Scenario> scenarios() throws IOException {
  41        List<Scenario> all = new ArrayList<>();
  42        for (Path file : suiteFiles()) {
  43            all.addAll(Scenario.read(file).scenarios());
  44        }
  45        return all.stream();
  46    }
  47
  48    private static List<Path> suiteFiles() throws IOException {
  49        try (var files = Files.list(SUITES)) {
  50            return files.filter(path -> path.toString().endsWith(".json")).sorted().toList();
  51        }
  52    }
  53
  54    @ParameterizedTest(name = "{0}")
  55    @MethodSource("scenarios")
  56    @DisplayName("every scenario replays and meets its expectations")
  57    void everyScenarioPasses(Scenario scenario) {
  58        HarnessContext context = new HarnessContext();
  59        HarnessRunner runner = new HarnessRunner(context.publisher(), context.autoApprovingGate(),
  60                null, CASSETTES, "claude-opus-5", 16000, context.catalog().conduct());
  61        HarnessRunner.Result result = runner.run(scenario, HarnessRunner.Mode.REPLAY);
  62        assertThat(result.failures())
  63                .as("%s — %s%n  why: %s%n  called: %s%n  failures: %s", scenario.id(),
  64                        scenario.utterance(), scenario.why(),
  65                        result.steps().stream().map(step -> step.tool()).toList(),
  66                        result.failures())
  67                .isEmpty();
  68    }
  69
  70    @Test
  71    @DisplayName("every scenario has a cassette, and the suite says which are authored")
  72    void cassettesAreAccountedFor() throws IOException {
  73        List<String> missing = new ArrayList<>();
  74        List<String> authored = new ArrayList<>();
  75        for (Scenario scenario : scenarios().toList()) {
  76            Path path = Cassette.pathFor(CASSETTES, scenario.id());
  77            if (!Files.exists(path)) {
  78                missing.add(scenario.id());
  79                continue;
  80            }
  81            if (Cassette.read(path).source() == Cassette.Source.AUTHORED) {
  82                authored.add(scenario.id());
  83            }
  84        }
  85        assertThat(missing)
  86                .as("a scenario with no recording is a scenario that is not being evaluated")
  87                .isEmpty();
  88        assertThat(authored)
  89                .as("authored cassettes exercise the runtime but are not evidence about the "
  90                        + "model; run ./harness.sh --record with a key to replace them")
  91                .hasSizeLessThanOrEqualTo(30);
  92    }
  93
  94    @Test
  95    @DisplayName("the three suites cover reads, trading and refusals, and refusals are a third")
  96    void theSuitesAreBalanced() throws IOException {
  97        List<Scenario> all = scenarios().toList();
  98        assertThat(all).hasSize(30);
  99        long refusals = all.stream()
 100                .filter(scenario -> scenario.tags().contains("refusal")).count();
 101        assertThat(refusals)
 102                .as("a suite that only measures whether the agent picks the right tool is "
 103                        + "measuring the easy half")
 104                .isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(10);
 105        long trajectories = all.stream()
 106                .filter(scenario -> scenario.tags().contains("trajectory")).count();
 107        assertThat(trajectories).isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(10);
 108    }
 109
 110    @Test
 111    @DisplayName("scenarios do not approve automatically unless they say so")
 112    void theApprovalGateIsUnderTestByDefault() throws IOException {
 113        long automatic = scenarios().filter(Scenario::approvesAutomatically).count();
 114        long total = scenarios().count();
 115        assertThat(automatic)
 116                .as("standing in for the human is the exception, and it is declared per scenario")
 117                .isLessThan(total / 2);
 118    }
 119
 120    @Test
 121    @DisplayName("the report scores selection, refusal and arguments separately")
 122    void theReportSeparatesTheScores() throws IOException {
 123        Scenario.Suite suite = Scenario.read(SUITES.resolve("brokerage-refusals.json"));
 124        List<HarnessRunner.Result> results = new ArrayList<>();
 125        for (Scenario scenario : suite.scenarios()) {
 126            HarnessContext context = new HarnessContext();
 127            results.add(new HarnessRunner(context.publisher(), context.autoApprovingGate(), null,
 128                    CASSETTES, "claude-opus-5", 16000, context.catalog().conduct())
 129                    .run(scenario, HarnessRunner.Mode.REPLAY));
 130        }
 131        Report report = Report.of(suite.name(), HarnessRunner.Mode.REPLAY, results);
 132        assertThat(report.clean()).as("%s", report.text()).isTrue();
 133        assertThat(report.refusalAccuracy()).isEqualTo(1.0);
 134        assertThat(report.text()).contains("refusal accuracy");
 135    }
